message:
Hey Sam,

I know this week's been hectic, and I hope you're not pushing yourself too hard. I tweaked a few of the games to make them more bite-sized: quick little breaks you can dip into whenever you need to reset. Just refresh the page to move to the next surprise.

Hope they help. Sending you warmth and strength.

Hat

P.S. I miss you sometimes, and I hope everything is going well for you.
